##############################################################################
### Analytic benchmark: Bhabha final-state focusing, round head-on beams.   ###
### Generated by benchmarks/make_inputs.py. Run it through wx_bhabha.py,    ###
### which adds the BHLUMI test species ele_bhl / pos_bhl.                   ###
### No crossing angle, no external fields, no QED (no beamstrahlung),       ###
### zero emittance and energy spread (no hourglass), rigid bunches.         ###
### The theory (benchmarks/bhabha_theory.py) reads this file back.          ###
##############################################################################

####################
### MY CONSTANTS ###
####################
my_constants.GeV   = q_e*1.e9
my_constants.micro = 1.e-6
my_constants.milli = 1.e-3

# BEAMS
my_constants.energy         = 45.6*GeV
my_constants.energy_eV      = energy / q_e
my_constants.gamma          = energy / (m_e*clight*clight)
my_constants.npart          = 20000000000.0
my_constants.nmacropart     = 4000000.0
my_constants.charge         = q_e * npart
my_constants.sigmax         = 10.0*micro
my_constants.sigmay         = sigmax
my_constants.sigmaz         = 1.0*milli
my_constants.zcut           = 4
my_constants.crossing_angle = 0.
my_constants.rotation_angle = 0.5*crossing_angle
# beta* is only used by wx_bhabha.py's vertex sampler (hourglass); the WarpX beams below are laminar
my_constants.betax          = 1000000000.0
my_constants.betay          = betax
# bunches start touching at z = 0 and the last tails cross at t = T
my_constants.muz            = zcut*sigmaz

# BOX
my_constants.Lx = 60*sigmax
my_constants.Ly = 60*sigmay
my_constants.Lz = 16*sigmaz
my_constants.nx = 512
my_constants.ny = 512
my_constants.nz = 1024
my_constants.dx = Lx/nx
my_constants.dy = Ly/ny
my_constants.dz = Lz/nz

# TIME
my_constants.T  = 2*zcut*sigmaz/clight
my_constants.dt = 0.5*dz/clight
my_constants.nt = ceil(T/dt)

# DIAGNOSTICS (luminosity check: N^2 / (4 pi sigmax sigmay) per crossing)
my_constants.bin_num_1d        = 512
my_constants.bin_center_min_1d = 0.
my_constants.bin_center_max_1d = 2.1*energy_eV
my_constants.bin_size_1d       = (bin_center_max_1d - bin_center_min_1d) / bin_num_1d
my_constants.bin_edge_min_1d   = bin_center_min_1d - 0.5 * bin_size_1d
my_constants.bin_edge_max_1d   = bin_center_max_1d + 0.5 * bin_size_1d
my_constants.bin_num_1d_eff    = bin_num_1d + 1

##########################
### GENERAL PARAMETERS ###
##########################
stop_time = T
amr.n_cell = nx ny nz
geometry.dims = 3
geometry.prob_lo = -0.5*Lx -0.5*Ly -0.5*Lz
geometry.prob_hi =  0.5*Lx  0.5*Ly  0.5*Lz
amr.max_level = 0

boundary.field_lo = open open open
boundary.field_hi = open open open
boundary.particle_lo = Absorbing Absorbing Absorbing
boundary.particle_hi = Absorbing Absorbing Absorbing

################
### NUMERICS ###
################
warpx.do_electrostatic = relativistic
warpx.const_dt = dt
warpx.grid_type = collocated
algo.particle_shape = 3
algo.particle_pusher = vay
warpx.poisson_solver = fft
warpx.use_2d_slices_fft_solver = 1
warpx.random_seed = random

#################
### PARTICLES ###
#################
particles.species_names = beam1 beam2

beam1.species_type = electron
beam1.injection_style = gaussian_beam
beam1.x_rms = sigmax
beam1.y_rms = sigmay
beam1.z_rms = sigmaz
beam1.x_m = 0.
beam1.y_m = 0.
beam1.z_m = -muz
beam1.npart = nmacropart
beam1.q_tot = -charge
beam1.x_cut = zcut
beam1.y_cut = zcut
beam1.z_cut = zcut
beam1.momentum_distribution_type = gaussian
beam1.uz_m = gamma
beam1.ux_m = 0.
beam1.uy_m = 0.
beam1.ux_th = 0.
beam1.uy_th = 0.
beam1.uz_th = 0.
beam1.initialize_self_fields = 1

beam2.species_type = positron
beam2.injection_style = gaussian_beam
beam2.x_rms = sigmax
beam2.y_rms = sigmay
beam2.z_rms = sigmaz
beam2.x_m = 0.
beam2.y_m = 0.
beam2.z_m = muz
beam2.npart = nmacropart
beam2.q_tot = charge
beam2.x_cut = zcut
beam2.y_cut = zcut
beam2.z_cut = zcut
beam2.momentum_distribution_type = gaussian
beam2.uz_m = -gamma
beam2.ux_m = 0.
beam2.uy_m = 0.
beam2.ux_th = 0.
beam2.uy_th = 0.
beam2.uz_th = 0.
beam2.initialize_self_fields = 1

###################
### DIAGNOSTICS ###
###################
diagnostics.diags_names = particles_in particles_out

# test leptons scraped at the walls (wx_bhabha.py sets save_particles_at_* for ele_bhl, pos_bhl)
particles_out.intervals = -1
particles_out.diag_type = BoundaryScraping
particles_out.format = openpmd
particles_out.openpmd_backend = bp

# test leptons still in the box at the end; wx_bhabha.py appends ele_bhl pos_bhl to this list
particles_in.intervals = nt
particles_in.diag_type = Full
particles_in.species =
particles_in.fields_to_plot = none
particles_in.format = openpmd
particles_in.openpmd_backend = bp
particles_in.dump_last_timestep = 1

warpx.reduced_diags_names = DiffLum_beam1_beam2
DiffLum_beam1_beam2.type = DifferentialLuminosity
DiffLum_beam1_beam2.intervals = nt
DiffLum_beam1_beam2.species = beam1 beam2
DiffLum_beam1_beam2.bin_number = bin_num_1d_eff
DiffLum_beam1_beam2.bin_max = bin_edge_max_1d
DiffLum_beam1_beam2.bin_min = bin_edge_min_1d
